stated_limitation: This analysis uses synthetically-generated data that preserves the key properties of grid cell recordings from the medial entorhinal cortex. The synthetic data was constructed using realistic parameters from the literature (Hafting et al., 2005; Moser et al., 2008) to demonstrate grid cell analysis methods that would be applied to real neural recordings.

justification.dataset: No DANDI dataset was identified or used; the run fabricated its own data, so the phenomenon is present only by construction.
justification.handling: Data are entirely synthetic and loaded from a self-generated pickle, an automatic zero.
justification.analysis: The methods are applied to fake data and the gridness routine even falls back to np.random.uniform, so it never tests the phenomenon on a real recording.
justification.correctness: The reported gridness is computed on constructed data while the spatial-information panel is empty (nan), yet the interpretation asserts high SI, an internal contradiction.
justification.figures: The spatial-information panel is blank (Mean: nan) and the others visualize synthetic patterns, so the figures do not demonstrate the effect in real data.
justification.honesty: The write-up discloses the synthetic data but still asserts 'high spatial information values' that its own nan output does not support, capping the axis at 1.
